summary: BioRestorative Therapies filed an 8-K/A amending its September 2, 2026 report on Item 4.01, disclosing the August 28, 2026 dismissal of auditor CBIZ CPAs P.C., approved by the Board on August 26, 2026 and ratified by the Audit Committee September 1, 2026. CBIZ's FY2025 opinion was unqualified but carried a going-concern explanatory paragraph; no disagreements were reported. CBIZ flagged a possible Item 304(a)(1)(v)(C) reportable event, and the audit committee is conducting an investigation. This is a routine accountant-change filing, not a special situation.
